publicationPolicy.note: Evidence & Measurement uses only reviewed visuals that directly teach measurement, interpretation, or a clearly labeled worked example. Missing methods remain explicit production gaps rather than receiving decorative science imagery.

measurement-question-model.title: Measurement Quality Chain
measurement-question-model.alt: Educational diagram showing how question definition, measurement quality and interpretation affect cultivation decisions.

baseline-controls-change-isolation.title: Monitored Cultivation Decision
baseline-controls-change-isolation.alt: Educational decision diagram showing how monitored observations, bounded changes and verification support cultivation decisions.

time-series-events-derived-metrics.title: VPD as a Derived-Metric Example
time-series-events-derived-metrics.alt: Educational diagram showing vapor pressure deficit as a calculated metric derived from measured environmental inputs.

records-interpretation-change-control.title: Media Testing, Batch Qualification & Reuse Decisions
records-interpretation-change-control.alt: Educational workflow showing standardized testing, recorded evidence and qualification decisions for a cultivation material batch.

gaps.title: Accuracy, Precision, Resolution & Uncertainty
gaps.neededVisual: A target-style comparison showing accurate/precise combinations, instrument resolution versus stated accuracy, uncertainty bounds and why extra decimal places do not prove measurement quality.

gaps.title: Calibration, Sensor Drift & Reference Cross-Check
gaps.neededVisual: A calibration workflow showing known standards, pre-check, adjustment where appropriate, post-check, maintenance, drift over time, reference-sensor comparison and a traceable calibration log.

gaps.title: Sensor Placement, Canopy Grid & Representative Sampling
gaps.neededVisual: A room/canopy map showing biased versus representative sensor locations, height and coordinate metadata, a repeatable spatial grid, raw values and why a room average can hide gradients.

gaps.title: Baseline, Control, Treatment, Randomization & Position Effects
gaps.neededVisual: A cultivation experiment timeline and bench layout showing baseline collection, contemporaneous controls, randomized or blocked treatment positions, one major variable changed and post-change verification.

gaps.title: Standardized Imaging, Scale & Scoring Anchors
gaps.neededVisual: A diagnostic photography protocol showing plant ID, overview plus close-up, scale reference, neutral lighting/white balance, tissue location, unedited original retention and anchored ordinal scoring.

gaps.title: Replication, Uncertainty, Correlation & Evidence Chain
gaps.neededVisual: A statistical-thinking diagram separating biological and technical replicates, sample size, spread, correlation from causation, confidence/uncertainty and the traceable path from raw observation to decision and recheck.
